column1: # Baseline corpus for cpp-kana v1 -> v2 behaviour comparison.
# One case per line, tab-separated: direction <TAB> text
#   direction = kana   : the text is fed to kanaToRomaji with each of nine option sets (default, compact,
#                        drop-sokuon, plain-hatsuon, drop-long-vowel, dash-long-vowel, uppercase, unknown-fail,
#   direction = romaji : the text is fed to romajiToKana (hiragana and katakana)
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are skipped. The file is UTF-8 with LF endings and is
# pinned by .gitattributes (`tests/data/** -text`), because the v1 snapshot below was produced from
# exactly these bytes and a CRLF checkout would change the input.
